info.title: API-DocTest-List Airline Flights Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Status API provides real-time updates on the status of airline flights. Users can retrieve detailed information regarding flight departures, arrivals, and any delays or cancellations. This API serves travel industries, airlines, and application developers who aim to enhance customer experiences with timely flight information. Typical consumers include airline companies, travel booking platforms, and airport authorities requiring reliable data for operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of a flight.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to check the current status of a specific flight. You can use this information to determine if the flight is on time, delayed, or canceled.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of flights. This body should contain the necessary parameters formatted as JSON to specify the details of the flight status being requested.

200.description: The flight status has been retrieved successfully.

ListAirlineFlightsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for fetching flight status. It is a simple string representation.
